method: GRPO-style hosted RL with Prime Verifiers single-turn environment

inference_status: Prime-hosted inference is live for the step-75 adapter from a local WSL terminal when using prime inference chat with a large max token budget such as --max-tokens 25000. Direct local weight-file inference remains blocked because Prime exposes private R2 checkpoint paths rather than downloadable PEFT adapter files.
